stories.story_fr: Le taux de vacance des centres commerciaux atteint son plus bas niveau depuis 2017 à 4,6 %.
stories.story_en: Shopping centre vacancy fell to a record low of 4.6%, the lowest since 2017.
stories.quote: Shopping Centre vacancy at 4.6%, down -20 bps vs. 2024

stories.story_fr: Amélioration d’environ -355 points de base du ratio d’endettement grâce à 2,2 milliards d’euros de cessions.
stories.story_en: LTV improved by about -355 bps thanks to €2.2 bn of disposals.
stories.quote: Improvement d’environ -355 points de base du ratio d’endettement grâce à 2,2 milliards d’euros de cessions

stories.story_fr: Acquisition d’une participation de 25 % dans St James Quarter, le centre commercial dominant d’Édimbourg.
stories.story_en: Acquired a 25% stake in St James Quarter, the dominant mall in Edinburgh.
stories.quote: Acquisition of a 25% stake in St James Quarter, a retail flagship asset in Edinburgh

stories.story_fr: Lancement du premier contrat de franchise de marque en Arabie Saoudite.
stories.story_en: Launch of the first brand franchising contract in Saudi Arabia.
stories.quote: Launch of capital-light growth initiatives through first franchising contract in KSA

stories.story_fr: AREPS à 9,58 € et proposition de distribution de 4,50 € par action, soit +30 % vs. 2024.
stories.story_en: AREPS at €9.58 and proposed cash distribution of €4.50 per share, up about 30% versus 2024.
stories.quote: 2025 AREPS at €9.58 and proposed distribution of €4.50/share, up c.+30% vs. FY-2024
